The '''Dethrain D-50''' was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[N-K Necrosis]] was known to possess this weapon.<ref name="SWG" />
